def test_user_registration_and_login():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "testpassword"

    payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "John",
        "lastName": "Doe"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=HTTPBasicAuth(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_catalogue_list_and_get():
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0, "Expected at least one item in catalogue"

    item_id = items[0]["id"]
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["id"] == item_id

def test_carts_add_and_retrieve():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    item_id = resp.json()[0]["id"]

    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": 15.0
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cart_items = resp.json()
    assert len(cart_items) > 0
    assert cart_items[0]["itemId"] == item_id

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_orders_full_checkout_workflow():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Jane",
        "lastName": "Doe"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    address_payload = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "EC1A 1BB",
        "street": "Main St",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json()["id"]

    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json()["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    item = resp.json()[0]

    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item["id"],
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": 10.0
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    order_data = resp.json()
    assert "id" in order_data
    assert order_data["payment"]["authorised"] is True
    order_id = order_data["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    orders_collection = resp.json()
    assert "_embedded" in orders_collection
    assert len(orders_collection["_embedded"]["customerOrders"]) > 0

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_orders_payment_decline():

    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Rich",

    }

    address_payload = {
        "city": "Paris",
        "country": "France",
        "number": "1",
        "postcode": "75001",
        "street": "Rue de Rivoli",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_id = resp.json()["id"]

    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "999",
        "expires": "01/30",
        "longNum": "9876543210987654",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json()["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    item = resp.json()[0]

    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item["id"],
        "quantity": 10,
        "unitPrice": 15.0
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 406, f"Expected 406, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert "Payment declined" in resp.json().get("message", "")
